base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_020"
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1."XCL_018" = T2."XCL_012"
WHERE (T1."XCL_029" IS NULL OR T1."XCL_029" = 0)
GROUP BY T1."XCL_018"
HAVING COUNT(T2."XCL_013") > (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(T3."XCL_013") AS cnt FROM hero_power AS T3 GROUP BY T3."XCL_012"))

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT s.XCL_019 || ' ' || s.XCL_020 AS full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.XCL_018 = hp.XCL_012
WHERE (s.XCL_028 IS NULL OR s.XCL_028 = 0)
GROUP BY s.XCL_018, s.XCL_019, s.XCL_020
HAVING COUNT(hp.XCL_013) > (
    SELECT AVG(power_count)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(hp2.XCL_013) AS power_count
        FROM hero_power hp2
        GROUP BY hp2.XCL_012
    )
)
